future.en: The future belongs to those who keep on dreaming.
future.cn: 未来属于那些不停做梦的人。

bright.en: With courage and effort, our future will be bright.
bright.cn: 凭借勇气与努力，我们的未来必定光明。

goal.en: Write down your goals and check them every week.
goal.cn: 把目标写下来，每周检查。

believe.en: Believe in yourself even when others doubt you.
believe.cn: 即使别人怀疑，也要相信自己。

thank.en: Thank everyone who walked this journey with us.
thank.cn: 感谢一路同行的每一个人。

goodbye.en: Goodbye is not an end, but a brand-new beginning.
goodbye.cn: 再见不是结束，而是全新开始。
